report:
Reviewed the complete claim, the sole ordinary ty.rs implementation association, all four ordinary tests and the explicit TODO test. Independently verified exact byte equality of current ty.rs, representation_spec.rs, binary_operators.rs and sage-test-harness/lib.rs against the historical input; this supports continuity but is not itself approval or execution evidence.

The claim requires explicit, elided, universal, existential, imported and synthesized origins to use Dummy; Dummy must not mean static, an inference variable or completed region erasure, and omitting lifetimes must not introduce ambiguity. Ty::Ref carries Lifetime and Lifetime has exactly one variant, Dummy, documented as deliberate deferral until unified inference/borrow checking. Thus the representation has neither static nor lifetime-variable identities, and its stated meaning is omission before analysis, not a borrow-analysis result. The explicit/elided/static signature test checks both parameter types and return type against Dummy and checks solver eligibility despite T: 'a. The generic impl test checks the universally bound reference Self type against Dummy and eligibility. These assertions detect accidental loss of references or treating lifetime syntax as unsupported. The clone test requires a diagnostic-free resolved static trait call with a synthesized Dummy reference receiver; the comparison test checks both synthesized shared operands of eq and lt, Bool result, static trait target and no diagnostics. Together these supply concrete non-ambiguity examples and synthesis coverage, not a universal proof of all origins. Captured setup helpers invoke the assertion callbacks; captured comparison fixture supplies ordinary u32 equality/ordering expressions.

The empty sage_meta::todo::types_lifetimes_dummy body provides no behavioral evidence. Its explicit imported/bound/inferred-origin coverage gap remains justified: completing this coverage requires fixtures exposing external lifetimes, additional bound/universal cases and existential/inferred origins with assertions on lowered Dummy references and absence of lifetime-induced ambiguity. The local generic example supplies some universal coverage but does not discharge that matrix. Accepted deferral remains TODO; this report does not claim imported/existential or exhaustive non-ambiguity behavior has been verified. No N/A entries exist. The historical rationale remains sufficient with these limits, and no edits are requested.

Execution: personally ran review start, review read captures and exact baseline comparison, then review record. No behavioral tests or build were run by this reviewer; the coordinator's reported 321 sage-meta tests and workspace build are separate execution evidence, not evidence that these four behavioral tests ran.
